conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.preconditions: Requires an explicitly authorized continuous-time interpretation and defined input domain; the following derivation assumes positive prices and integer multipliers at least one
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.catalogAlgorithmCorrection: The derived catalog's p/(m-1) sorting key is incorrect. For m>1 the correct ascending key is p*m/(m-1).
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.proof: At a common current rate r, ordering a,b costs (p_a+p_b/m_a)/r and b,a costs (p_b+p_a/m_b)/r. Subsequent rate is identical, so choose a first iff p_a*m_a*(m_b-1) <= p_b*m_b*(m_a-1).
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.multiplierOne: For positive prices, place all multiplier-one items after items with multiplier greater than one; their internal order is arbitrary.
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.comparison: Use exact cross products with an integer type large enough for the eventual declared bounds, not floating-point keys.
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.semanticCheckerSuggestion: Validate a full permutation, then verify adjacent exact comparator inequalities under the declared positive-price domain; accept any order among equal keys.
conditionalContinuousAlgorithm.independentOracleSuggestion: For small n, enumerate every permutation and evaluate sum(price_i/product_of_prior_multipliers) using exact rational arithmetic; compare the submitted permutation's objective against the exhaustive minimum. Include tied keys, multiplier one, and the wrong-key counterexample.
